before: Bookmarks were preserved and navigated, but no operation added or removed one.
after: insertBookmark and deleteBookmark add and remove bookmark marker pairs. Typing at a marker lands after it, and an untracked deletion removes the bookmarks it encloses.
reason: Both operations and the edit rules reduce to existing canonical tree primitives: marker nodes inserted, removed, and moved within a paragraph. The journal replicates those node changes without changing the shared format, and new marker ids are actor-striped. Show bookmarks is local view state.
